description: This file defines a utility class PageBuilderUtils with a static method build404 that constructs a 404 page URL or path based on MerchantStore data.

classes.name: PageBuilderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for building page paths or URLs.

methods.name: build404
methods.description: Constructs a 404 page identifier or URL by appending the store's template to a predefined notFound page constant.
